issue: DistantHorizonsStandalone #58 - Added White/Blacklist System for what Worlds to Support DH

findings.summary: Feature request: Add a whitelist/blacklist system to control which worlds/dimensions DH is enabled for. Currently DH runs in all dimensions which may not be desired.
findings.root_cause: No dimension filtering exists. ForgeServerProxy.serverLevelLoadEvent() and ForgeClientProxy initialize DH for every world without checking a whitelist.
evidence: ForgeServerProxy.java:146: serverLevelLoadEvent loads for all WorldServer instances
ForgeClientProxy.java: Initializes client level without filtering

gap_analysis.invariant_violated: User control over which worlds use DH

proposed_fix.approach: Add config option for dimension whitelist/blacklist and check before initializing DH for a world
implementation_steps: 2. Add helper method to check if dimension allowed

falsification_test.description: If filter doesn't work, check dimension name matching

confidence_reason: Clear implementation path, config system already exists
